headlines.title: China's National Bureau of Statistics said nationwide consumer prices (CPI) rose 0.5% YoY
headlines.summary: China's National Bureau of Statistics said nationwide consumer prices (CPI) rose 0.5% YoY in July 2026 and fell 0.1% MoM.
headlines.title_zh: 中国国家统计局称全国居民消费价格指数（CPI）同比上涨0.5%
headlines.summary_zh: 中国国家统计局称，2026年7月全国居民消费价格（CPI）同比上涨0.5%，环比下降0.1%。

headlines.title: 国家统计局：7月份，核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，同比上涨0.9%
headlines.summary: 金十数据8月9日讯，国家统计局城市司首席统计师董莉娟：7月份，受国际输入性因素影响，居民消费价格指数（CPI）环比下降0.1%，同比上涨0.5%，扣除食品和能源价格的核心CPI环比上涨0.3%，同比上涨0.9%，CPI总体保持温和上涨。国内部分行业需求增加，但受输入性和季节性等因素影响，工业生产者出厂价格指数（PPI）环比下降0.7%，同比上涨3.5%，涨幅比上月回落0.6个百分点。

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: In July, core CPI rose 0.3% month-on-month and 0.9% year-on-year
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 9 - Dong Lijuan, Chief Statistician of the Urban Department of the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS): In July, affected by international input factors, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) fell 0.1% month-on-month and rose 0.5% year-on-year. Excluding food and energy prices, the core CPI rose 0.3% month-on-month and 0.9% year-on-year, with CPI maintaining a moderate upward trend overall. Domestic demand in some industries increased, but affected by input and seasonal factors, the Producer Price Index (PPI) fell 0.7% month-on-month and rose 3.5% year-on-year, with the gain narrowing 0.6 percentage points from the previous month.

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: In July, PPI year-on-year growth moderated
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 9 - Dong Lijuan, Chief Statistician of the Urban Department of the NBS: On a year-on-year basis, national PPI rose 3.5%, with the gain narrowing 0.6 percentage points from the previous month. By industry, among the main industries with price increases, oil and natural gas extraction, petroleum, coal and other fuel processing, and chemical raw materials and chemical products manufacturing rose 3.2%, 8.2%, and 9.1% respectively; non-ferrous metal mining and dressing, and non-ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing rose 22.6% and 20.2% respectively; ferrous metal smelting and rolling processing rose 2.7%, with gains in all of these narrowing from the previous month. These six industries together contributed approximately 2.55 percentage points to the year-on-year PPI increase. Coal mining and washing rose 27.1%, electrical machinery and equipment manufacturing rose 5.7%, and computer, communication and other electronic equipment manufacturing rose 4.4%, with gains all narrower than the previous month.

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: AI drives iterative upgrades of consumer electronics, with increased demand and higher prices for related products; tablet computers, computers, and mobile phone prices rose 11.3%, 5.5%, and 1.0% month-on-month respectively, collectively contributing about 0.0 percentage points to the monthly CPI increase

headlines.title_en: China's July CPI rose 0.5% year-on-year, versus prior increase of 1%
headlines.summary_en: In July 2026, the national consumer prices rose 0.5% year-on-year. Among them, urban areas rose 0.5%, rural areas rose 0.4%; food prices fell 1.5%, non-food prices rose 0.9%; consumer goods prices rose 0.2%, and service prices rose 0.7%. On average from January to July, national consumer prices rose 0.9% from the same period of the previous year.

headlines.summary_en: In July 2026, the national Producer Price Index rose 3.5% year-on-year and fell 0.7% month-on-month. The purchasing prices of industrial producers rose 5.5% year-on-year and fell 1.0% month-on-month. On average from January to July, the Producer Price Index rose 1.8% from the same period of the previous year, and the purchasing prices of industrial producers rose 2.8%.

headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: In July, CPI rose mildly year-on-year, with gold jewelry up 24.6%
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 Data, August 9 - Dong Lijuan, Chief Statistician of the Urban Department of the NBS: On a year-on-year basis, national CPI rose 0.5%, maintaining a moderate increase. The year-on-year CPI gain narrowed 0.5 percentage points from the previous month, mainly due to the narrowing rise in gasoline prices. Gasoline prices rose 1.0%, with the gain narrowing 16.0 percentage points from the previous month, reducing the upward pull on CPI by approximately 0.45 percentage points compared to the previous month, and driving energy price gains down to 0.6%. Industrial consumer goods excluding energy rose 1.5%, with the gain narrowing 0.2 percentage points from the previous month, contributing approximately 0.37 percentage points to the year-on-year CPI increase. Among them, b>gold jewelry, personal care products, and household appliances prices rose 24.6%, 1.7%, and 0.2% respectively/b>, with gains all narrowing, together contributing approximately 0.13 percentage points to the year-on-year CPI increase.

headlines.title_en: Beijing CSRC Bureau: Intensify efforts to serve new quality productive forces, continuously support high-quality development of the capital's capital market
headlines.summary_en: [Beijing CSRC Bureau: Intensify efforts to serve new quality productive forces, continue supporting high-quality development of the capital market] The Beijing CSRC Bureau held the 2026 Beijing district sponsor institution regulatory exchange meeting. The responsible official conveyed the spirit of the CSRC's Party building and regulatory work symposium, reported on the district's sponsor supervision progress, exchanged new ideas and concepts on sponsorship work, and raised work requirements. A relevant China Securities Association official guided how to further improve issuance sponsorship quality and introduced the association's next steps for self-regulatory supervision. Representatives from 22 sponsor institutions attended, with some sharing experiences based on their own work.

From a capital market perspective, content quality, long-term IP operation capability, diversified production layouts, and AI business implementation results have become key criteria for institutions evaluating the value of film and TV listed companies. Recently, attention on the A-share film and media sector has been rising. Multiple institutions have released views stating that with the maturity of video large model iterations, AI is no longer limited to conceptual exploration but is gradually being implemented in real business scenarios such as animated films, micro-dramas, post-production rendering, and digital humans, with some companies already realizing AI business revenue. A review of brokerage research reports shows that institutions generally favor two major directions: first, the AI transformation of traditional film and TV leaders, and second, the AI short drama and AI comic drama track. headlines.title_en: National Bureau of Statistics: CPI up 0.5% year-on-year in July
headlines.summary_en: [NBS: In July, the Consumer Price Index (CPI) rose 0.5% year-on-year] In July 2026, the national consumer prices rose 0.5% year-on-year. Among them, urban areas rose 0.5%, rural areas rose 0.4%; food prices fell 1.5%, non-food prices rose 0.9%; consumer goods prices rose 0.2%, and service prices rose 0.7%. On average from January to July, national consumer prices rose 0.9% from the same period of the previous year. In July, the national Producer Price Index rose 3.5% year-on-year and fell 0.7% month-on-month. The purchasing prices of industrial producers rose 5.5% year-on-year and fell 1.0% month-on-month. On average from January to July, the Producer Price Index rose 1.8% from the same period of the previous year, and the purchasing prices of industrial producers rose 2.8%.
